_comment: Settings another plugin's block declares itself (its own block.json attributes) that an SGS extension paints, seeded as block_attributes rows with source 'native' (sgs-update-v2.py::_seed_native_setting_rows) so the cloning route can pair them with the draft by part (css_element) and property. Only settings SGS prints through its own scoped stylesheet belong here: WooCommerce's chip colours reach the chip buttons through includes/product-filter-look.php when sgsChipPaintButtons is on. Never a setting the block's own plugin prints as inline style (its style.* supports): R-47-10 refuses a core style attribute in a tree the route writes. A native colour setting holds a CSS colour, never an SGS palette slug.
